content.short: DeFi Rate compares DeFi protocols and Web3 apps to help users find suitable crypto applications.
content.description: DeFi Rate is an independent research outlet that provides high-quality information on legitimate Web3 companies, helping readers make informed choices. Users can read, compare, and contrast hundreds of DeFi protocols and Web3 apps to understand what they offer and how each may be useful for their needs. The site covers a wide range of projects across the Web3 landscape, enabling comparisons that help identify what matters most. With more than 3 million readers to date, DeFi Rate is widely recognized as a trusted source for accurate Web3 information and reliable analysis.
